nav.policy: Asclepius organises patient-provided information. It does not diagnose or prescribe; clinical decisions remain yours.

home.title: Home
home.subtitle: What is waiting for you right now.
home.incomingWhy: A request arrives here when a patient chooses you and picks what to share.
home.activeWhy: A consultation becomes active once you accept a request.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Everyone who has consulted you, most recent first.
patients.emptyWhy: A patient appears here when they request a consultation with you.

dashboard.title: Consultations
dashboard.subtitle: Patients who have requested a consultation with you.

case.reviewBeforeAccept: Review what the patient shared, then accept or decline.
case.declineReason: Reason for declining (optional, shown to the patient)
case.confirmComplete: Mark this consultation as completed? Notes and prescriptions become read-only.
case.notShared: The patient did not share this.
case.history: Medical history shared by the patient
case.sharedConsultations: Earlier consultations shared by the patient
case.independentOpinion: Independent opinion from another doctor, shown as written. It is not reconciled with your assessment.
case.sharedPrescriptions: Earlier prescriptions shared by the patient
case.ownPrevious: Your earlier consultations with this patient
case.assessmentHint: Visible to the patient and attributed to you.
case.authorNotice: You are the author. Asclepius does not suggest, check or alter medications.
case.acceptFirst: Accept the consultation to message the patient, add notes or prescribe.
case.readOnly: This consultation is completed and read-only.

ai.title: AI interpretation
ai.subtitle: Machine-generated from the patient's own words. Not clinical advice — check it against the original above.
ai.none: No AI interpretation for this item.
ai.unavailable: AI processing was unavailable for this item. The patient's original text is shown above.

view.familyNote: A relative's information — not the patient's own history.
view.checkOk: Meaning preserved across all three versions
view.checkReview: The English version may not match the patient's words
view.checkAdded: In the English but not in the patient's words
view.checkDropped: In the patient's words but missing from the English
view.attributionLost: The English does not say this was about a relative

docAi.title: Machine reading
docAi.subtitle: Text read from the patient's document and items extracted from it. Not clinical advice — check everything against the original file.
docAi.failed: This document could not be read. Use the original file.
docAi.noItems: No items were extracted from this page.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Shown to patients in the directory.
profile.name: Name
profile.registrationHint: Checked by an administrator before your account was approved.

admin.title: Doctor applications
admin.subtitle: A doctor appears to patients and sees patient information only after you approve them.

checklist.title: Before you approve
checklist.register: Look the registration number up on the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission register.
checklist.match: Check that the name and qualification on the register match the application.
checklist.reason: If something does not match, reject with a reason the doctor can act on.

empty.rejected: No applications have been turned down.

admin.conflict: Another doctor account uses this registration number.
admin.reasonPlaceholder: For example: this registration number is not on the council register.
admin.revokeWarning: The doctor loses access to their consultations at once and no longer appears in Find Care.
admin.approvedNotice: {name} is approved and can now receive consultation requests.
admin.rejectedNotice: {name} was not approved. They can see your reason.
